notes.title: Making Perception_ERROR Easier
notes.notes: This is an update where the virus questions have been reduced from 80 to 40, therefore it should be a lot easier to win the game now! :D

notes.title: Perception_ERROR Fixes
notes.notes: For everyone's sanity in regards to the horror bundle when playing Perception_ERROR, I added a counter for how many viruses you've completed, along with more helpful tips, I have also cancelled out repeating audio at the beginning for less annoyance, and made the virus entity harder to spawn, so enjoy.

notes.title: Game Breaking Bug Fix
notes.notes: Fixed The Big Day game breaking bug.
